notes.title: V0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]1. New Features[/h1]
[h2]1.1. New Characters Added[/h2]
The player character is replaced with a new one. Several new NPC characters have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/b9786280ecd12101cda7fb9699c724eb31d85617.jpg[/img]
[h2]1.2. 10 New Levels Added[/h2]
New levels include scenarios like a fire in an underground parking lot and climbing to rescue people.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/85aa1ec8ddd938423df90c917a136e7d65c567d3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/40d389c54da0e205b18e72aeda70b02107fff23f.jpg[/img]
[h2]1.3. Weather Options Added[/h2]
You can now select weather conditions like sunny, rainy, snowy, and foggy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/97c888b474cc050ecc8cb5c6b8ec0e45e218a897.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/729257c164e72742a254cfc4cc4ea402a84c5ce5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/5b3ed0fa58a893cf2cfb9907ee120a689b436148.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/1eca85f4fc745354cb4581fab24dc6fcee047227.jpg[/img]
[h2]1.4. Others[/h2]
Added the ability to skip the opening and ending cutscenes.
[h1]2. Fixes[/h1]
Fixed numerous bugs.
